6fdb2c58-e5e6-4321-9889-f00ddc534912.shortDescription: The Configuration Agent automates the initial monitoring setup SAP system.
6fdb2c58-e5e6-4321-9889-f00ddc534912.description:
The Greenfield Configuration Agent automates the complete initial monitoring setup for a newly onboarded SAP system in SAP Cloud ALM. When a new system is registered in the CALM landscape, the agent analyzes the system type, release, and role within the landscape, then generates a full monitoring configuration proposal based on SAP best practices, the relevant Solution Library templates, and any active project context associated with that system. The agent deploys the approved configuration directly to the target system, validates that telemetry data begins flowing correctly, and provides a commissioning report confirming monitoring coverage. It eliminates the multi-hour manual process of consulting documentation, selecting KPIs, configuring health monitoring services, and validating alert thresholds for each new system.
This agent is currently only available for eligible customers enrolled within a corresponding EAC program

8b156ecf-2e33-4f76-8767-144703f6d26c.name: Asset Accounting Anomaly Detection Agent
8b156ecf-2e33-4f76-8767-144703f6d26c.shortDescription: Improves audit readiness by preventing inaccurate or invalid asset postings.
8b156ecf-2e33-4f76-8767-144703f6d26c.description: For accountants closing the books, finding fixed asset errors usually means digging through multiple SAP GUI transactions or running custom reports — work that eats into an already tight close calendar. This agent does that digging for you, scanning fixed asset master data and key figures to flag the issues that normally require manual review: depreciation keys that don't match the asset class default, assets sitting at negative net book value, and active sub-assets still attached to a deactivated main asset. Beyond these built-in checks, accountants can ask the agent direct, natural-language questions about asset data and get back analyzed answers with clear next steps — no transaction codes, no custom report builds. The result: anomalies get caught earlier, close cycles move faster, and accountants spend less time hunting for problems and more time resolving them. Please note: This agent is currently only available for eligible customers enrolled within a corresponding EAC program.

Increase analyst productivity because users don’t need to navigate multiple SAP GUI interface transactions or build custom reports; accountants redirect time from manual review toward higher-value activities

113d5082-468a-487c-876b-5c8d1a2332f1.description: The agent introduces a proactive approach to training compliance management in SAP SuccessFactors Learning. Instead of relying on static reports or manual follow-ups, the agent continuously evaluates learning assignments, due dates, learner behavior, and operational signals to identify potential compliance risks early, often 4–6 weeks before deadlines are missed. It provides clear visibility into at-risk learners, highlights underlying causes such as pending approvals, missed enrollments, or limited availability, and enables guided, in-context actions for both managers and learners. By shifting from reactive tracking to proactive execution, the agent helps organizations improve completion rates, reduce administrative effort, and maintain a consistent, auditable compliance record.
